title: Gas Station in Gouache Contest Deadline Tonight
content: Gouache billboard artfrom Charlie Allen's blog.Today at midnight is the deadline for the "Gas Station in Black-and-White Gouache" assignment. I've been posting the entries so far on aFacebook event page, so you can see and comment on what everybody has been doing, all around the world. I'll add the rest of the entries by tomorrow morning.---Gas Station Contest Announcement
